title: Restrictions on the use of an attestation (attestation.usage_restriction.codes)

terms.label: The customer must not refer to this attestation on products or in communication.
Applies to the raw material only; says nothing about a finished product.
A finished-product claim requires the customer's own certification.
Valid only together with a current copy of the certificate.
Applies only to material from the named production site.
Applies only to batches delivered with the corresponding batch certificate.
May be shared with authenticated partners only.
